description: This file contains unit tests for the ObserverManager class, testing its behavior for subscribing, notifying, unsubscribing, handling exceptions, expiration, concurrent modifications, filtering, and enumeration.

classes.name: ObserverManagerTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the ObserverManager class, verifying its correctness under various scenarios.

methods.name: CollectionModified
methods.description: Tests that modifications to the observer collection during notification do not cause exceptions and behave as expected.

methods.name: SubscribeDuringNotify_ObserversAreUpdatedImmediately
methods.description: Verifies that observers added during notification are immediately visible within the current notification cycle but are not notified in the same cycle.

methods.name: UnsubscribeDuringNotify_ObserversAreUpdatedImmediately
methods.description: Checks that observers unsubscribed during notification are removed from the collection and are not notified afterwards.

methods.name: SyncNotify_SubscribeAndUnsubscribe_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures that synchronously subscribing and unsubscribing observers during notification updates the collection correctly.

methods.name: ExceptionInNotificationCallback_RemovesObserver
methods.description: Tests that an observer is removed from the collection if its notification callback throws an exception.

methods.name: SyncNotify_ExceptionInNotificationCallback_RemovesObserver
methods.description: Tests synchronous notification callback exception handling, ensuring observers are removed upon error.

methods.name: ExpiredObservers_AreRemovedDuringNotify
methods.description: Verifies that observers which have expired based on the expiration duration are removed during notification.

methods.name: ClearExpired_RemovesOnlyExpiredObservers
methods.description: Tests that only observers past their expiration are cleared.

methods.name: Clear_RemovesAllObservers
methods.description: Confirms that clearing the observer collection empties it entirely.

methods.name: CanModifyObserversConcurrently
methods.description: Tests thread-safe modifications to the collection under concurrent subscribe and notify operations.

methods.name: PredicateFiltersObserversToNotify
methods.description: Checks that predicate filtering correctly limits which observers are notified.

methods.name: AsyncPredicateFiltersObserversToNotify
methods.description: Verifies that asynchronous predicates filter observers correctly during notification.

methods.name: EnumeratorWorksCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures the collection can be enumerated correctly after some observers are added.

methods.name: SubscribingExistingObserver_UpdatesLastSeenTime
methods.description: Verifies that resubscribing an existing observer updates its last seen time, preventing expiration.

methods.name: SubscribingExistingObserver_UpdatesObserverValue
methods.description: Checks that resubscribing updates the observer's value.

methods.name: SetExpirationDuration_AffectsExpiration
methods.description: Tests that changing the expiration duration affects observer expiry as expected.

methods.name: ClearDuringNotification_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies that clearing the collection during notification does not disrupt the notification process.

methods.name: ModifyDuringEnumeration_WorksWithoutExceptions
methods.description: Ensures that modifying the collection during enumeration does not cause exceptions and updates are reflected correctly.
